create_Episode: create an Episode with start_position, start_rotation, scene_id, and episode_id for a Habitat simulation
create_Dataset: build a Dataset subclass to manage a collection of Episode objects for embodied AI tasks
get_episodes_by_scene: get all episodes from a Dataset filtered by a specific scene_id using get_scene_episodes
split_dataset: split a Dataset into multiple subsets using get_splits with collate_scene_ids and allow_uneven_splits options
iterate_episodes: iterate over episodes with an EpisodeIterator that supports cycling, shuffling, and group_by_scene options
